reference.question: How many integers have an absolute value less than \(\sqrt{10}\)?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Approximate and list the integers

\(\sqrt{10}\approx3.16\). The integers satisfying \(|x|<3.16\) are \(-3\), \(-2\), \(-1\), \(0\), \(1\), \(2\), and \(3\), for a total of \(7\).
